admission.justification: Reusing facts under incomplete identity can silently change fail-closed catalog findings or relative-import ownership.

applicability: Dependency-facts derivation for the Git-observed Python source population.
conditions: Only per-file imports, literals and reader flags are reused; tracked paths, module ambiguity and all cross-file consumer graphs are rebuilt.
Identity includes implementation bytes, Python version, dotted module, package-initializer status and the parsed source bytes.
Unusable or wrong-shaped stored facts are ignored and never change the derived result.
exclusions: No start-up speed budget or elapsed-time evidence.
No cache of cross-file closure or source population.

evidence: test_dependency_facts_store.py; shared-clone field equality and filled-store catalog validation

statement: Per-file import, literal and reader facts are keyed by complete source and derivation identity while every cross-file graph is rebuilt.
